posts.text: ADHD memory is like a hard drive full of half-downloaded files.
If you’re tired of forgetting the stuff that matters, I built something for that. (It’s ADHD-proof, I swear.)
ADHD + immigrant household = every day is a group project you didn’t sign up for.
People with ADHD forgets what I’m doing halfway through doing it and that’s my superpower now.
ADHD is the reason I think differently — and that’s my edge.
I didn’t forget my budget—it just stopped being interesting.
